title: SRD importer section anchors do not match the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF
description:
When npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack (added in 0m9.6) runs the importer against the real vendored PDF at packages/core/sources/dnd5e-srd-5.1/SRD_CC_v5.1.pdf, runImporter throws SectionNotFoundError: 'start heading not found: no line matched /^Using Ability Scores$/'. The default coreRules section anchor in scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/sections.ts expects an exact 'Using Ability Scores' line that is not present in the SRD 5.1 PDF as extracted by pdfjs. Other anchors likely also need adjustment.

The importer was developed against a small fixture PDF generated by pdfkit at test time (see test/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/pipeline.test.ts); the anchor strings were never validated against the real SRD 5.1 PDF.

This blocks the canonical-regen PR (the eventual replacement of the seed records.json with full importer output) and is the underlying reason the 0m9.6 verify:dnd5e-srd-pack command currently exits 2 instead of 1.

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack (after this PR lands).
notes: PR #130 open: extractor heading-merge + new default anchors + best-effort hazards/treasureTables in orchestrator. Follow-up bead loreweaver-fct filed for two-column spell parser.
close_reason: Fixed by PR #130 (merged). Importer now matches real SRD 5.1 chapter structure; spell parser two-column issue tracked separately in loreweaver-fct.
